title: Models, Indicators, and Categories — Predictive Analysis
description: Models and Indicators form the predictive analysis system available on sites with predictive_model=true. These are read-only from the agent's perspective; creating new models/indicators is done manually by admins.

model_fields.name: Display name.
model_fields.site_scope_ids: Site scopes this model is available in (join table).

indicator_fields.name: Display name.
indicator_fields.analysis_suitable: Boolean. Must be true for analysis use.
indicator_fields.analysis_query: SQL or API query template for computing indicator values.

layer_analysis_fields.analysis_suitable: Boolean on Layer. Must be true for analysis endpoint inclusion.
layer_analysis_fields.analysis_type: Layer enum includes 'histogram', 'categorical', 'text', but current validation is stricter: COG layers may use 'histogram' or 'categorical'; non-COG layers may only use 'histogram' when analysis_suitable=true.
layer_analysis_fields.analysis_query: Template query string for the analysis computation.
layer_analysis_fields.analysis_body: JSON object with additional analysis parameters.
layer_analysis_fields.analysis_text_template: Handlebars-style template for text analysis results.

notes: The agent should NOT create or modify Models/Indicators — these are seeded by data engineers.
When creating an analysis-capable layer, set analysis_suitable: true and choose analysis_type according to the provider-specific validation rules.
The analysis panel reads layers with analysis_suitable=true from the active site scope.
Do not assume that historical 'text' analysis examples are currently accepted by model validation.
